caption_hook: Nevada has been a giant lake, a silver-rich volcano and a sea full of 50-foot sea monsters.

layers.name: LAHONTAN TUFA
layers.hook: Towers built by an Ice Age lake
layers.what: During the Ice Age, giant Lake Lahontan covered much of northwest Nevada. Minerals in its water grew into strange limestone towers called tufa as springs bubbled up.
layers.bonus: Pyramid Lake, a leftover of Lahontan, still shows the towers along its shore.

layers.name: COMSTOCK LODE
layers.what: Hot water circulating through cracks in volcanic rock deposited veins of silver and gold. The ore sat hidden until miners found it in 1859 at Virginia City.
layers.bonus: Its riches helped fund the Union side of the Civil War and made Nevada a state in 1864.

layers.name: AZTEC SANDSTONE
layers.hook: A desert bigger than the Sahara
layers.what: Huge sand dunes once blew across the Southwest, and their wind-swept slopes turned to stone. The iron in the grains stains the cliffs red, orange and white.
layers.bonus: Valley of Fire and Red Rock Canyon, both near Las Vegas, are carved from it.

layers.name: LUNING FORMATION
layers.what: A warm shallow sea covered central Nevada. Giant ichthyosaurs, swimming reptiles that could pass 50 feet long, died here and were buried in limy mud that hardened to stone.
layers.bonus: Berlin-Ichthyosaur State Park protects a quarry of them, and Nevada's state fossil is one.

layers.name: POLE CANYON LIMESTONE
layers.hook: A cave made from an ancient reef bed
layers.what: This limestone began as lime mud in a warm Cambrian sea. Heat and pressure later turned it partly to marble, and water slowly dissolved caves into it.
layers.bonus: Lehman Caves, in Great Basin National Park, is carved inside it.

layers.name: THE BASEMENT
layers.hook: The oldest rock in the state
layers.what: Far beneath Nevada lies Precambrian gneiss and schist, baked and squeezed deep in the crust. Faulting has lifted some of it into view in the state's southeast corner.
layers.bonus: It is over three times older than the first animals with hard shells.
